label: Within a finite two-phase material-turnover signature, a vitalist interpretation, a process-only…
meaning: Finite countermodels to two attempted entailments: (1) integrated and self-maintaining material turnover entails substantial unity; (2) such unity entails an irreducible soul. The functionalist substitute is the positive, continuous causal organization stipulated in the common history, not a denial of life. The formal test does not settle whether this mechanism is a sufficient ultimate explanation or whether the displayed models are metaphysically possible. Source-derived claims, if later added, need independently pinned witnesses.
